# mci-messages-reader test fixtures

All fixtures here are **synthesized at test time** with fake handles and
synthetic bodies — NO real user Messages content has been imported. The
`integration.rs` test programmatically materializes each fixture into a
`tempfile::tempdir()` so the repo carries the generator, not the
generated bytes.

Per the V2-P7 dispatch and the ADR-0030 §3(e) default-deny posture as
amended by §3(f):

- Real user `chat.db` content MUST NEVER appear in this directory or in
  any test under `mci-messages-reader/`.
- Any fixture that needs sender / recipient / body content uses
  obviously-synthetic values: `+15551234567`, `bob@example.com`,
  `"Hello from Alice (synthetic)."`, `"482917 is your verification
  code."`, and similar.
- Fixtures stay in-process; nothing is written outside
  `tempfile::tempdir()`.
- The synthesized OTP digit groups (`482917`, `271845`, …) are randomly
  generated for fixture purposes — they reveal no real code.
